_what: ⛔ SNG-641 §2–3 (C14) — THE MARKS A SOVEREIGN'S SUPPLY LINE LEAVES. Aevi's principle: CONFIRM THE LINE, NEVER THE HAND. Found alone, every mark here has an ordinary explanation, and that is the test each one had to pass; the player's own collecting is what makes them mean anything. ⛑ THE SOVEREIGN IS NEVER NAMED BY THE GM — `sovereignGM` is sealed, and the name comes only from somebody who knows: an anti-Sovereign (R41c), a Precursor, or the thing itself when it arrives.
_consistency: ⚡ The marks are the same in every save and never overlap between Sovereigns. A player who learns the hollow coin in one game recognises it in the next, and that is the reward for paying attention — so it has to be the same knowledge each time.

marks.mark: a ring of rays burned round an empty centre — on crates, arena tokens, the edges of board filings
goods sold unwrapped, maker's name and price burned on the outside, nothing sealed
they sleep with the lamp lit, keep no curtains, and confess on the board before anyone accuses them
a public mark on the board with no record behind it
a street where every shutter is off its hinges and nobody remembers deciding it
a coin with its face worn smooth on purpose; it passes at full weight
a contract with one blank ruled line below the signatures
notches cut in a debtor's door frame, one for each thing asked for
they say by leave before they act, even alone
an empty chair kept at the head of the table, at councils that took a grant
Dusklow crates stencilled cold goods, do not open, heavier than the manifest
a nine-sided Cogitarium token on someone who was never a Cogitant
a sleeper who does not age, eyes moving under the lids
sleepers humming the same four bars, in every region
a bed made neat and still warm in a house empty a month
a milestone whose count does not go down however far you walk toward the town it names
letters returned stamped no such place, addressed to places that still exist
a map with one road drawn off its edge, in a hand nobody at the map-maker's recognises
